item.title: Why the B-25 Mitchell Was One of the Loudest Aircraft of World War II
item.description: World War II aircraft were loud by modern standards, but the North American B-25 Mitchell stood out even among its peers. item.title: How the RAAF’s B-24 Liberators Helped Win the Air War in the Pacific
item.description: First flown in 1939, the B-24 became the most-produced American aircraft of World War II, with more than 18,000 built.
